verses.t: The Prophet frowned and turned away
verses.pickthall: He frowned and turned away
verses.yusufAli: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away
verses.rodwell: HE FROWNED, and he turned his back
verses.sale: The prophet frowned, and turned aside

verses.t: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]
verses.pickthall: Because the blind man came unto him
verses.yusufAli: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting)
verses.rodwell: Because the blind man came to him
verses.sale: because the blind man came unto him

verses.t: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
verses.pickthall: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
verses.yusufAli: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)
verses.rodwell: But what assured thee that he would not be cleansed by the Faith
verses.sale: And how dost thou know whether he shall peradventure be cleansed from his sins

verses.t: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him
verses.pickthall: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him
verses.yusufAli: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him
verses.rodwell: Or be warned, and the warning profit him
verses.sale: or whether he shall be admonished, and the admonition shall profit him

verses.t: As for he who thinks himself without need
verses.pickthall: As for him who thinketh himself independent
verses.yusufAli: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient
verses.rodwell: As to him who is wealthy
verses.sale: The man who is wealthy

verses.t: To him you give attention
verses.pickthall: Unto him thou payest regard
verses.yusufAli: To him dost thou attend
verses.rodwell: To him thou wast all attention
verses.sale: thou receivest respectfully

verses.t: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified
verses.pickthall: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)
verses.yusufAli: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding)
verses.rodwell: Yet is it not thy concern if he be not cleansed
verses.sale: whereas it is not to be charged on thee, that he is not cleansed

verses.t: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
verses.pickthall: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
verses.yusufAli: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly
verses.rodwell: But as to him who cometh to thee in earnest
verses.sale: But him who cometh unto thee earnestly seeking his salvation

verses.t: While he fears [Allah]
verses.pickthall: And hath fear
verses.yusufAli: And with fear (in his heart)
verses.rodwell: And full of fears
verses.sale: and who feareth God

verses.t: From him you are distracted
verses.pickthall: From him thou art distracted
verses.yusufAli: Of him wast thou unmindful
verses.rodwell: Him dost thou neglect
verses.sale: dost thou neglect

verses.t: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder
verses.pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment
verses.yusufAli: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction
verses.rodwell: Nay! but it (the Koran) is a warning
verses.sale: By no means shouldest thou act thus

verses.t: So whoever wills may remember it
verses.pickthall: So let whosoever will pay heed to it
verses.yusufAli: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance
verses.rodwell: And whoso is willing beareth it in mind
verses.sale: Verily the Koran is an admonition; -- and he who is willing retaineth the same

verses.t: [It is recorded] in honored sheets
verses.pickthall: On honoured leaves
verses.yusufAli: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour
verses.rodwell: Written on honoured pages
verses.sale: written in volumes honourable

verses.t: Exalted and purified
verses.pickthall: Exalted, purified
verses.yusufAli: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy
verses.rodwell: Exalted, purified
verses.sale: exalted, and pure

verses.t: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels
verses.pickthall: (Set down) by scribes
verses.yusufAli: (Written) by the hands of scribes
verses.rodwell: By the hands of Scribes, honoured, righteous
verses.sale: by the hands of scribes honoured

verses.t: Noble and dutiful
verses.pickthall: Noble and righteous
verses.yusufAli: Honourable and Pious and Just
verses.rodwell: Cursed be man! What hath made him unbelieving
verses.sale: and just

verses.t: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he
verses.pickthall: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful
verses.yusufAli: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah
verses.rodwell: Of what thing did God create him
verses.sale: May man be cursed! What hath seduced him to infidelity

verses.t: From what substance did He create him
verses.pickthall: From what thing doth He create him
verses.yusufAli: From what stuff hath He created him
verses.rodwell: Out of moist germs
verses.sale: Of what thing doth God create him

verses.t: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him
verses.pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him
verses.yusufAli: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions
verses.rodwell: He created him and fashioned him
verses.sale: Of a drop of seed doth He create him; and He formeth him with proportion

verses.t: Then He eased the way for him
verses.pickthall: Then maketh the way easy for him
verses.yusufAli: Then doth He make His path smooth for him
verses.rodwell: Then made him an easy passage from the womb
verses.sale: and then facilitateth his passage out of the womb

verses.t: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him
verses.pickthall: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him
verses.yusufAli: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave
verses.rodwell: Then causeth him to die and burieth him
verses.sale: Afterwards He causeth him to die, and layeth him in the grave

verses.t: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him
verses.pickthall: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life
verses.yusufAli: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again)
verses.rodwell: Then, when he pleaseth, will raise him again to life
verses.sale: hereafter, when it shall please Him, He shall raise him to life

verses.t: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him
verses.pickthall: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him
verses.yusufAli: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him
verses.rodwell: Aye! but man hath not yet fulfilled the bidding of his Lord
verses.sale: Assuredly. He hath not hitherto fully performed what God hath commanded him

verses.t: Then let mankind look at his food
verses.pickthall: Let man consider his food
verses.yusufAli: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it)
verses.rodwell: Let man look at his food
verses.sale: Let man consider his food; in what manner it is provided

verses.t: How We poured down water in torrents
verses.pickthall: How We pour water in showers
verses.yusufAli: For that We pour forth water in abundance
verses.rodwell: It was We who rained down the copious rains
verses.sale: We pour down water by showers

verses.t: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts]
verses.pickthall: Then split the earth in clefts
verses.yusufAli: And We split the earth in fragments
verses.rodwell: Then cleft the earth with clefts
verses.sale: afterwards We cleave the earth in clefts

verses.t: And caused to grow within it grain
verses.pickthall: And cause the grain to grow therein
verses.yusufAli: And produce therein corn
verses.rodwell: And caused the upgrowth of the grain
verses.sale: and We cause corn to spring forth therein

verses.t: And grapes and herbage
verses.pickthall: And grapes and green fodder
verses.yusufAli: And Grapes and nutritious plants
verses.rodwell: And grapes and healing herbs
verses.sale: and grapes, and clover

verses.t: And olive and palm trees
verses.pickthall: And olive-trees and palm-trees
verses.yusufAli: And Olives and Dates
verses.rodwell: And the olive and the palm
verses.sale: and the olive, and the palm

verses.t: And gardens of dense shrubbery
verses.pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage
verses.yusufAli: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees
verses.rodwell: And enclosed gardens thick with trees
verses.sale: and gardens planted thick with trees

verses.t: And fruit and grass
verses.pickthall: And fruits and grasses
verses.yusufAli: And fruits and fodder
verses.rodwell: And fruits and herbage
verses.sale: and fruits, and grass

verses.t: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock
verses.pickthall: Provision for you and your cattle
verses.yusufAli: For use and convenience to you and your cattle
verses.rodwell: For the service of yourselves and of your cattle
verses.sale: for the use of yourselves and of your cattle

verses.t: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
verses.pickthall: But when the Shout cometh
verses.yusufAli: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise
verses.rodwell: But when the stunning trumpet-blast shall arrive
verses.sale: When the stunning sound of the trumpet shall be heard

verses.t: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
verses.pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
verses.yusufAli: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother
verses.rodwell: On that day shall a man fly from his brother
verses.sale: on that day shall a man fly from his brother

verses.t: And his mother and his father
verses.pickthall: And his mother and his father
verses.yusufAli: And from his mother and his father
verses.rodwell: And his mother and his father
verses.sale: and his mother, and his father

verses.t: And his wife and his children
verses.pickthall: And his wife and his children
verses.yusufAli: And from his wife and his children
verses.rodwell: And his wife and his children
verses.sale: and his wife, and his children

verses.t: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him
verses.pickthall: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)
verses.yusufAli: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others
verses.rodwell: For every man of them on that day his own concerns shall be enough
verses.sale: Every man of them, on that day, shall have business of his own sufficient to employ his thoughts

verses.t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright
verses.pickthall: On that day faces will be bright as dawn
verses.yusufAli: Some faces that Day will be beaming
verses.rodwell: There shall be faces on that day radiant
verses.sale: On that day the faces of some shall be bright

verses.t: Laughing, rejoicing at good news
verses.pickthall: Laughing, rejoicing at good news
verses.yusufAli: Laughing, rejoicing
verses.rodwell: Laughing and joyous
verses.sale: laughing, and joyful

verses.t: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust
verses.pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them
verses.yusufAli: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained
verses.rodwell: And faces on that day with dust upon them
verses.sale: And upon the faces of others, on that day, shall there be dust

verses.t: Blackness will cover them
verses.pickthall: Veiled in darkness
verses.yusufAli: Blackness will cover them
verses.rodwell: Blackness shall cover them
verses.sale: darkness shall cover them

verses.t: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones
verses.pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked
verses.yusufAli: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity
verses.rodwell: These are the Infidels, the Impure
verses.sale: These are the unbelievers, the wicked
